title: Simon Renard (London) to Prince Philip, 19 Feb 1554, AGS Estado leg. 808 f. 184 (DECODE R9959)

plaintext.source: Contemporary Spanish version calendared in Tyler, CSP Spain XII (1949) pp. 100-123; archivist's note on f. 184v says the decipherment is in 'no. 21'

transcription.notes: Closed from the calendar and Tomokiyo after viewing the address leaf.

system.summary: Granvelle-Saint Mauris cipher of 1547-48 (Pich-Ponce PP1), per Tomokiyo; DECODE: alphabet, graphic signs, numerals. Not examined here.
system.notes: Key published by Pich-Ponce; not applied here.

prior_solution.where: Tyler (ed.), CSP Spain XII (1949), 19 Feb 1554, Simancas E. 808 (Spanish translation); Tomokiyo, cryptiana spanish2C (2026) identifies the key (PP1) and reads the opening

conditions.human_role: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded.

solution.what: Grepped Tomokiyo's spanish2C page cache for R9959: Renard, 19 Feb 1554, Estado 808 f. 184, cipher = Granvelle-Saint Mauris PP1, opening 'Monsieur ... puis mes dernieres lectres'.

Fetched the 6 DECODE images with the stored cookie; address leaf reads 'Monseigneur le prince d'Espaigne' (recipient Philip, not Charles V as Tomokiyo heads it) and an archivist's note 'creo está descifrada en el nº 21'.
British History Online, CSP Spain XII, Feb 1554 16-20: 'Simon Renard to Prince Philip', 19 Feb, Simancas E. 808, Spanish translation, ~650 words, opening 'Since I last wrote' = the cipher's opening.

outcome.method_basis: The contemporary Spanish decipherment is calendared in CSP Spain XII (Tyler 1949, 19 Feb 1554, Simancas E. 808) and Tomokiyo's spanish2C page identifies the key (PP1) and reads the opening; both were found before any work on the cipher, and nothing was transcribed or deciphered here.
outcome.notes: Calendared 1949 from the contemporary Spanish decipherment; key published (PP1); catalogue entry 202 removed, no write-up.
